description: Clinical calculators — Standard bedside formulas from whatever inputs you pass (offline, instant): BMI + WHO category, BSA (Mosteller), ideal/adjusted body weight (Devine), BMR + TDEE (Mifflin-St Jeor, activity=sedentary|light|moderate|active|very_active), eGFR (CKD-EPI 2021 race-free) with CKD G-stage, creatinine clearance (Cockcroft-Gault, actual/ideal/adjusted weight), mean arterial pressure, QTc (Bazett, Fridericia, Framingham) with prolongation flag, anion gap (albumin-corrected), corrected calcium, glucose-corrected sodium. Inputs: age, sex, weight (kg) or weight_lb, height (cm) or height_in, creatinine (mg/dL) or creatinine_umol, sbp, dbp, hr, qt, na, cl, hco3, ca, albumin, glucose; calc= limits to e.g. egfr,crcl. Returns what each skipped calculation still needs. Informational, not medical advice. Price: $0.002 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: health_clinical_calc
